pattern: SVG treemap as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "treemap") of role="img" tiles in size order with roving focus; one level shown at a time with drill-down (Enter/Space, click), Backspace and a breadcrumb (nav "Treemap path") to go up, a polite announcement of the shown level, and a data table of the whole hierarchy.

roles.role: group with aria-roledescription "treemap" (localized), named by the title
img with an aria-label: label, value, share of the shown level, and the item count for groups
navigation named "Treemap path" with an ordered list: ancestor buttons, then the current level (aria-current="location"); shown only below the top level
table (native) with caption, column headers (Name, Value, Share of parent), and row headers (the name path); wide tables scroll in a focusable region
aria-hidden (decorative duplicates of the accessible data)

aria.value: id of the visible (or visually hidden) title
description id (when provided) and the generated summary id
Localized "{label}: {value} ({percent})", groups "{label}: {value} ({percent}), {count} items", for example "Engineering: 50 (50%), 2 items"
0 on exactly one tile (roving); other tiles have none
"Showing {path}" after each drill, for example "Showing All / Engineering"
Table open state and the table region id

keyboard.action: Next tile in size order (largest first); ArrowLeft/ArrowRight are swapped in RTL.
Opens the group; focus moves to its largest tile. Ignored on leaf tiles.

keyboard.context: Tile focused below the top level (drillDown on)
keyboard.action: Goes up one level; focus moves to the group you came from.
Shows that level (native button); focus moves into the tiles.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); it returns on the next move.
Breadcrumb buttons (below the top level), then one tab stop for the plot (the active tile), then the Show data table button and table region.

focus: Roving focus over the tiles of the shown level in size order. Drilling down moves focus to the largest tile; going up (Backspace, breadcrumb, drillTo) moves it to the group you came from, when focus was in the chart. Re-renders (resize, update) keep focus on the same tile.
notes: The generated summary names the shown path (below the top level), the item count, the total, and the three largest items with their shares, for example "Showing All / Engineering. treemap, 2 items, total 50. Largest: Web (60%) and API (40%)."
Tiles are keyboard-reachable in size order (largest first), matching the squarified layout, which places large tiles first.
Tiles are separated by a surface-colored gap, so neighbors need no mutual contrast; textures (patterns) and printed labels are the non-color cues.
The data table lists the whole hierarchy (not only the shown level), so every value is reachable without drilling.
Forced colors: tiles use CanvasText with Canvas separators and textures; focus uses Highlight; breadcrumb buttons use LinkText.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack) is pending.
aria-roledescription support varies; screen readers without it announce "group".
Whether a tile opens is conveyed by its item count in the accessible name, not by a role; Backspace is not discoverable without documentation (the breadcrumb is the visible alternative).
